data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald's social welfare office approved Grundsicherung im Alter (basic income support for the elderly) for Annika Beispielsteiner starting 1 December 2026, paying €412.64 per month after crediting her pension income of €768.36 and covering her full rent.
data.explanation: This is a benefits decision in your favour: from December 2026 you will receive €412.64 each month on top of your pension, and your rent is fully covered. If you disagree with how the amount was calculated, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Kreisverwaltung; the app shows the deadline for this based on when the letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action, the decision as stated simply takes effect.

key_facts.quote: Ab Dezember 2026 zahlen wir Ihnen monatlich 412,64 €.

key_facts.quote: Ihre Altersrente von 768,36 € haben wir als Einkommen angerechnet.

key_facts.quote: Bekannt gegeben ist ein Bescheid, den wir mit einfachem Brief schicken, am vierten Tag nach dem Versand (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X).

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against the benefit decision
items.action: If you disagree with the decision (e.g. the calculated amount), submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the decision becomes final as stated.
